videoName: Capital Q flagship — KUUZA AI (AI presenter)
tone: Confident, executive, crisp. Medium-close shot, steady eye line.
script: Hello. I'm an AI presenter, introducing KUUZA AI. Every sales leader knows the problem: new reps learn on real customers, and real customers rarely give second chances. KUUZA AI describes itself as an AI simulator and coach for sales, service and human communication. A rep picks a scenario, a cold call, a discovery call, an angry complaint, and speaks naturally with an AI persona by voice, video or text. The persona pushes back with tone and attitude. The rep gets instant scoring and a debrief, and managers see team analytics. The company says its simulations add real-world noise, like poor signal and interruptions, and are built for accents and communication norms across Africa, Asia and the Middle East. Founded by Zino Mario and Excel Chukwu, KUUZA offers a free demo, with no account needed. Simulate today. Dominate tomorrow.
